svg.title: Compound code map
svg.desc: The Compound code map of the open-source Hono repository in its Everything view. The pointer rests on src/context.ts, which is also selected, so the files it imports and the files that import it, among them compose.ts, headers.ts, middleware.ts and html.ts, stay lit with their names while the rest of the graph fades. The file list shows 531 files in 44 folders, the graph footer reads 531 files · 1,027 imports · 829 drawn, the Changed tab counts 2, and the inspector describes context.ts as 800 lines of TypeScript with 8 imports, 73 importers and 35 symbols.
